title: Director Customs Quality Program
text:
**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Develops total Customs Brokerage quality policies, programs and initiatives to improve the quality of organizational processes and services.
* Oversees evaluation of current processes to determine areas of improvement.
* Establishes quality improvement project teams and oversee progress and results.
* Develops new and advanced tools, methods and systems to ensure quality improvement throughout the Customs Brokerage organization.
* Define standard operating procedures and ensure adherence to documented procedures.
* Standardize U.S Customs Quality Program and establish into all operations.
* Adherence to all U.S. Customs Brokerage regulations.
* Establish Customs Brokerage training program in accordance with 19 CFR 111.28 and maintain training records.
* Create and maintain internal policy and programs to ensure regulatory compliance within Customs Brokerage operation.

**OTHER SKILLS/ABILITIES**

* Effective use of quality tools such as Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis, etc.
* Demonstrated initiative, ability to exercise good judgment, and ability to achieve results through others are required.
* Strategy and planning: must possess an ability to think ahead and plan over a 12–24-month time span as well as strong client orientation and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and excellent time management abilities are necessary.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in quality or compliance management.
* Minimum 5 to 10 years’ supervisory or managerial experience required.

**CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES**

* Commitment to pursue Customs Brokers License (LCB).

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Talking, hearing and using hands to operate computer equipment.
* Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

**Why Should You Work for Crane?**

At Crane, we believe in providing our employees with excellent benefits at a Great Place to Work.

We offer:

* Quarterly Incentive Plan
* 136 hours of Paid Time Off which equals 17 days for the year, that can be used for Sick Time or for Personal Use
* Excellent Medical, Dental and Vision benefits
* Tuition Reimbursement for education related to your job
* Employee Referral Bonuses
* Employee Recognition and Rewards Program
* Paid Volunteer Time to support a cause that is close to your heart and contributes to our communities
* Employee Discounts
* Wellness Incentives that can go up to $100 per year for completing challenges, in addition to a discount on contribution rates

Come join the leader in logistics and take your career in the right direction.
